Dominican Republic beach volleyball player Ysaires Restituyo Personal information Nationality Dominican Republic Born Dominican Republic Beach volleyball information Current teammate Years Teammate Tours (points) 2009 Ana Ligia Fabian 55 Ysaires Restituyo is a female beach volleyball player from Dominican Republic , who played in the NORCECA Beach Volleyball Circuit 2007 [ 1 ] with Cinthia Piñeiro , 2008 , [ 2 ] with Ingrid Carmona and 2009 [ 3 ] with Ana Ligia Fabian ; at Santo Domingo , Dominican Republic .
